staff.band.label.description: Label above the rotating word on the volunteer's screen, which is compared with the word on the attendee's pass.

staff.band.retry.description: Replaces the band word when it stops refreshing. A stale band on this screen is the dangerous one: a volunteer comparing against it would reject a legitimate pass, so the word is replaced rather than left looking current.

staff.itemValue.description: An item with the attendee's choice for it, such as a T-shirt size. item is the item's name; value comes from the attendee's registration.

staff.lookup.failed.defaultMessage: Ingresso não encontrado. Confira o código
staff.lookup.failed.description: The typed ticket code matches no attendee.

staff.lookup.help.description: Label of the manual lookup's ticket code field.

staff.lookup.inputLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the manual lookup's ticket code field.

staff.lookup.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Muitas buscas em pouco tempo. Espere um pouco antes de tentar novamente
staff.lookup.rateLimited.description: The lookup's miss budget is spent. Not a fault and not a server problem: it clears itself in a few minutes, so unlike the server error it does not send the volunteer away from their counter.

staff.lookup.submit.description: Submit button of the manual lookup.

staff.lookup.summary.defaultMessage: Sem câmera? Busque pelo código do ingresso
staff.lookup.summary.description: Expander that opens the manual lookup by ticket code.

staff.outcome.duplicate.description: The item had already been collected. item is the item's name.

staff.outcome.notEntitled.description: The attendee is not entitled to the item. item is the item's name.

staff.outcome.redeemed.description: Confirmation after an item is handed over. item is the item's name.

staff.redeemFailed.description: Recording a redemption failed for a reason worth retrying.

staff.redeemForbidden.defaultMessage: Sua estação não tem acesso a este item. Atualize a página
staff.redeemForbidden.description: Refused because the item is not this station's. The button should not have been tappable, so the volunteer's stations changed while the card was open; reloading picks up the new ones.

staff.redemption.notEntitled.description: State of an item the attendee is not entitled to.

staff.redemption.otherStation.description: State of an item another station hands over. Says where to send them rather than that something is wrong: the attendee will get it, just not here.

staff.redemption.pending.description: State of an item the attendee has not collected yet, matching the word on the attendee's own pass.

staff.redemption.redeemed.description: State of an item already collected, matching the word on the attendee's own pass.

staff.review.close.description: Closes the redemption card for the attendee just scanned.

staff.review.slideHint.defaultMessage: Deslize a linha para confirmar a retirada
staff.review.slideHint.description: Said once under the item list, because a tap no longer does anything. Hidden from assistive technology: the keyboard and screen-reader path confirms on activation and has nothing to slide.

staff.scanner.cameraAccessError.defaultMessage: Sem acesso à câmera. Use o campo de busca abaixo
staff.scanner.cameraAccessError.description: The camera could not be opened; points to the manual lookup below.

staff.scanner.cameraAccessRequest.description: Shown while the browser asks for camera permission.

staff.scanner.defaultHint.description: Hint under the scanner while it waits for a pass. Addressed to a volunteer mid-shift with a queue in front of them: short, and says what to do rather than what happened. The attendee copy is warm; this is not, it is a work tool.

staff.scanner.error.forbidden.defaultMessage: Você não tem permissão para validar retiradas
staff.scanner.error.forbidden.description: The volunteer's account may not record redemptions.

staff.scanner.error.internal.defaultMessage: Problema no servidor. Chame o suporte
staff.scanner.error.internal.description: A server fault. It is not the attendee's problem and re-scanning will not clear it, so the volunteer fetches whoever runs the admin laptop.

staff.scanner.error.notFound.description: A scanned pass matches no attendee.

staff.scanner.error.rateLimited.defaultMessage: Muitas leituras. Espere um pouco antes de tentar novamente
staff.scanner.error.rateLimited.description: Too many scans in a short time; it clears by itself.

staff.scanner.error.validation.defaultMessage: Ingresso vencido ou inválido. Peça para atualizar a tela ({seconds, number}s)
staff.scanner.error.validation.description: A scanned pass was expired or malformed. Passes rotate, so the attendee refreshing their screen fixes it; seconds is how long one pass lasts.

staff.scanner.header.description: Heading over the staff QR scanner, where a volunteer scans an attendee's pass.

staff.scanner.help.defaultMessage: Se não funcionar, use o campo de busca abaixo
staff.scanner.help.description: Fallback instruction under the scanner: the manual lookup below it works without a camera.

staff.scanner.processing.description: Shown while a scanned pass is being checked.

staff.scanner.success.description: Shown when a scanned pass is accepted.

staff.serverError.defaultMessage: Problema no servidor. Dirija-se à mesa de suporte
staff.serverError.description: A fault on our side rather than a problem with the pass. Re-scanning fixes a bad read and fixes nothing here, so the volunteer should stop trying and fetch someone.

staff.slowResponse.defaultMessage: Servidor indisponível. Tente novamente em instantes
staff.slowResponse.description: A scan or a redemption timed out, or the server was too busy to take it. A timed-out redemption may still have been recorded; tapping again is safe, as the server records an item only once.
